tools.name: feedam_get_active_disasters
tools.description: Get currently active FEMA-declared disasters where D-SNAP (Disaster SNAP) may be available. D-SNAP provides emergency food benefits to households in declared-disaster areas, often regardless of normal SNAP eligibility. Returns disaster name, type, declaration date, affected counties, and D-SNAP info
